title: OpenClaw for Solopreneurs: Replace Your VA With a 24/7 AI Agent
summary: Virtual assistants cost $15–40/hour and work 8 hours. OpenClaw on Blink Claw works 24/7 from about $45/month per agent. Here's the 8 tasks solopreneurs automate first — and how to set each one up.
body_markdown:
Start in review-only mode. For the first two weeks, configure your agent to draft everything but send nothing. You review every output before it goes anywhere.


Once you trust specific output types — like meeting prep briefs or content calendar drafts — you can reduce the review loop for those. Keep human review for anything that goes external: emails to clients, invoices, public posts.


The mistake risk is lower than most people expect. Where agents fail is on ambiguous rules, not clear ones. Specific` SOUL.md` rules produce consistent outputs.
